reviewer: Codex assistant subagent; not a human reviewer
method: Separate source-to-claim review of all 17 frozen cases. Model labels were visible; the parent had already identified why_it_matters:0. This is not blinded validation or ground truth. No live model rerun or prompt tuning.

reviews.rationale: The exact R-1 row identifies Advanced Innovative Technologies, PE 0604250D8Z, organization OSD and the defense-wide RDT&E account. These fields support the institutional description.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: Use the exact program title and account context.

reviews.rationale: The cited R-1 row names the budget line but contains no Strategic Capabilities Office mission narrative. A resolvable amount does not establish the program-to-office relationship or capabilities claim.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: Attach the matching mission narrative fact ID and review the exact passage before publication.

reviews.rationale: The R-1 row contains no statement about SCO methods or the listed partner organizations.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: Attach the specific partnership narrative; a top-line workbook amount is insufficient.

reviews.rationale: The R-1 row establishes neither workforce size, labor arrangements, management structure nor the annual prototype-team count.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: Attach the staffing and project-team passage and preserve its source edition.

reviews.rationale: The R-1 row does not list project names, their classification status or the reason their descriptions are short.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: Cite the individual project narratives that establish the named examples and stated classification limits.

reviews.rationale: The supplied amount row does not establish Pele, the demonstration schedule, output, transport requirements or safety/compliance claims.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: Attach the Pele narrative; distinguish planned requirements from achieved or certified outcomes.

reviews.rationale: The R-1 row does not name HGWS or establish its technical objectives or architecture.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: Attach the specific HGWS passage and retain the aims-to-demonstrate wording.

reviews.rationale: The R-1 row contains no transfer percentages, receiving program identities or repeated-year transfer rule.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: Attach exact transfer evidence with fiscal-year scope; do not infer an annual policy from the amount row.

reviews.rationale: The recursive workbook input explicitly declares FY2024 actuals on basis=toa. The amount is supported, but actual amounts spent misstates total obligation authority as expenditures.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: FY2024 actual total obligation authority was $988,235 thousand (about $988.2 million), reported in PB2026.

reviews.rationale: The recursive FY2025 workbook input declares measure=total, basis=toa and 940431 USD thousands. The claim calls it a total without upgrading it to enacted funding.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: For added clarity, name total obligation authority and PB2026; retain total rather than enacted.

reviews.rationale: The FY2026 amount and request status are supported. Rose asserts a comparison, but this case supplies only FY2026 evidence and no comparison endpoint. Prior cases are not evidence supplied to this independent question.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: The FY2026 request is $1,163,452 thousand (about $1.16 billion). Add the FY2025 fact and statuses before describing a rise.

reviews.rationale: The explicit change record supplies 223021 USD thousands and pct=23.71; recursive inputs establish FY2026 request and FY2025 total. Both endpoints are present. This review reads exported arithmetic rather than treating Jev as a calculator.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: Name the comparison explicitly: FY2026 request versus FY2025 total obligation authority; do not call the FY2025 total enacted.

reviews.rationale: The supplied N957 workbook cell establishes only the 749452-thousand discretionary request. The reconciliation amount and complete additive relationship are absent from this case.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: Attach reconciliation fact f3ddb240c3103673 and total fact ae4f1bee1cec54e4, then check the sum deterministically.

reviews.rationale: The exact workbook row declares FY2026, measure=reconciliation-request and 414000 USD thousands.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: Retain request and the TOA/PB2026 context.

reviews.rationale: The supplied R-1 program total does not establish the PDI subset, its two funding pots, year-over-year change or five transitioning projects. Spending also exceeds the TOA evidence supplied.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: Attach specific PDI narrative and financial receipts, preserve proposed funding status and distinguish plans from completed transitions.

reviews.rationale: The exact R-2 project row supports 7712.804 USD millions for AllPriorYears, scoped to project 250. Drawn is ambiguous about cash versus funding, and one cumulative total does not establish sustained annual scale over time.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: The PB2026 R-2 reports $7,712.804 million for project 250 across all prior years. Omit drawn and the continuity inference.

reviews.rationale: The exact R-1 record names organization OSD and the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Defense-Wide account.
reviews.suggested_revision_or_action: Retain institutional and account scope; the record does not identify an award recipient.
